MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 41 November 7, 1972
ADDITIONAL SUBSCRIPTION OF THE PHILIPPINES TO THE CAPITAL STOCK OF THE
INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATION
WHEREAS, there were pending before the Congress prior to the promulgation of Proclamation No. 1081,
dated September 21, 1972, certain priority measures vital to the national development program of the
Government, and which were duly certified by the President as urgent measures;
WHEREAS, one of these priority measures is a bill authorizing additional subscription to the capital stock of
the International Development Association in accordance with the resolution adopted by member nations to
augment the resources of the Association;
WHEREAS, the Philippines has been recently a recipient of a credit from the International Development
Association in the aggregate amount of $10 million and other projects are still being considered for financing
by the International Development association which has partially satisfied the great need for funds of the
Philippine Government for its economic development projects:
WHEREAS, it is imperative that the necessary authority for the Philippines to put up the required additional
subscription to the capital stock of the International Development Association in the amount of $196,240 be
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E, MARCOS, President of the Philippines by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander in Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, do hereby decree and order that the House Bill
amending Section One of Republic Act No. 2687, as hereto attached is hereby adopted, and approved and
made as part of the law of the land.
This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
